summary: Frontend-only E2E test of Nandish: The Journey (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844). PASSED: landing (title, character image, Begin button -> /journey); journey map lock states (S2 locked + 'Complete Season 1' banner, locked-node toast, S3 locked); full play-through of all 9 levels 1.1->2.6 using choice-option-0/1/2 — reveal-panel appears every time with 'What Nandish actually did', rationale, impact chips, badge; choices disabled after reveal; complete-continue advances; 2.6 shows 'Finish Season 2 & unlock Season 3', toast 'Season 2 complete. Season 3 unlocked.' and S3 card turns dark with season3-open-button; progress persists after reload (nj_progress_v1). Wishlist: 5 toggles, total/count update correctly (850,1150,2250,2400,2800), remove works, progress bar 93%, header nav badge shows $2800, persists after reload. Pitch: unlocked hero + hire-to-unlock toast, all sections (skills/projects/interests/deliverables/contacts) render; reset-progress clears both LS keys and shows locked state with go-play-button. Design prompt: copy puts 4692 chars on clipboard + toast; download yields nandish-the-journey-design-prompt.md (4692 chars). Spelling: only 'Supertails' and 'Wispr' found; no SuperTales/SuperTails/Whisper on any page. Mobile menu works (4 nav items). FAILED: 2 bugs (below).

ui_bugs.issue: Opening a locked level (e.g. /level/2.1 with no progress) or an invalid level (/level/9.9) by direct URL or page refresh shows a BLANK page (only the header). No redirect, no toast. Cause: navigate() and toast() are called during render, then the component returns null. React Router logs 'You should call navigate() in a React.useEffect()' and the navigation is dropped on first render. With client-side navigation the redirect works, but the toast 'That level is still locked.' fires twice.

The animated waveform has no fixed height, so its container height changes all the time (bar heights animate 6px to ~44px). This moves everything below it up and down: the hire-to-unlock-button Y position swung 761px -> 794px within 1 second. Users see layout jitter, and Playwright cannot click the button without force=True ('element is not stable'). Fix: give the Waveform wrapper a fixed height, e.g. h-12.

issues: Radix warning: DialogContent is missing DialogTitle and Description (accessibility). Add a VisuallyHidden SheetTitle and SheetDescription.

action_items: LevelPlay.jsx: move the locked/invalid-level redirect out of render. Return <Navigate to='/journey' replace /> and show the toast once inside useEffect, so deep links and refreshes on locked or invalid levels redirect instead of showing a blank page.
Pitch.jsx: give the Waveform container a fixed height (e.g. className='flex h-12 items-end ...') so the content below stops moving.
Header.jsx mobile Sheet: add SheetTitle and SheetDescription (can be visually hidden) to clear the Radix accessibility warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: LevelPlay calls navigate/toast as side effects during render. This is an anti-pattern: it breaks on the first render and runs twice under StrictMode.
LevelPlay handleContinue on the last level always shows the 'Season 3 unlocked' toast, even when replaying 2.6 after Season 3 is already unlocked. Minor.
GameContext useMemo has deps [completed, cart] but the functions are recreated on every render. This works, but useCallback or no memo would be cleaner. Minor.
Sum of all 5 wishlist items = $2800, below the $3000 goal (the UI shows $200 headroom). Check that this is intended.
seed_data_creation: None. Only browser localStorage (nj_progress_v1, nj_wishlist_v1) was set or cleared in the test browser.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All state is in localStorage. To unlock S3, seed nj_progress_v1 with all 9 ids. Wishlist item ids: item-standing-desk(850), item-mic(300), item-cloud-compute(1100), item-nap-pillow(150), item-snack-counter(400). Clicking hire-to-unlock-button needs force=True until the waveform jitter is fixed. Retest: direct load of /level/2.1 with empty progress should redirect to /journey with a single toast.
rca of the issue: Blank page: LevelPlay returns null after calling navigate() synchronously in render. On a fresh mount (direct URL) React Router v6 ignores navigate before its effects are ready and only logs a warning, so the user is stuck on null content. Reproduce: localStorage nj_progress_v1='[]', then open /level/2.1 -> blank. Mitigation: use the <Navigate> component or a useEffect.
